body.translated_text: Oṃ. Homage to all the glorious <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bodhisattvas</s>!

body.text: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān deveṣu trāyastriṃśeṣu viharati sma / sudharmāyāṃ devasabhāyāṃ mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena mahatā ca bodhisattvasaṃghena bhikṣuśataiḥ śakreṇa ca devatānāmindreṇa sārdham / tatra khalu bhagavān prajñapta evāsane niṣadya uṣṇīṣamavalokitaṃ nāma samādhiṃ samāpadyate sma / samanantarasamāpannasya bhagavata uṣṇīṣamadhyādimāni mantrapadāni niścaranti sma /
body.translated_text: Thus have I heard. At one time, the <s>Bhagavat</s> (Blessed One) was dwelling among the gods of the <s>Trāyastriṃśa</s> (Thirty-Three) heaven, in the divine assembly-hall <s>Sudharmā</s>, with a great assembly of <s>bhikṣus</s> and a great assembly of <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, with hundreds of <s>bhikṣus</s>, and together with <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods. There, the <s>Bhagavat</s>, having sat upon the very seat prepared [for him], entered the <s>samādhi</s> (meditative absorption) called '<s>Uṣṇīṣamavalokita</s>' (Observation of the Crown-Protuberance). Immediately upon the <s>Bhagavat</s>'s entering [this samādhi], these <s>mantra</s>-words issued forth from the midst of his <s>uṣṇīṣa</s> (crown-protuberance):

body.translated_text: Homage to the Blessed <s>Uṣṇīṣa</s>, pure, stainless, immaculate, svāhā! Homage to the Blessed One of the unimpeded <s>uṣṇīṣa</s>! Homage to the <s>Buddha</s>! Homage to the <s>Dharma</s>! Homage to the <s>Saṃgha</s>! Homage to the <s>koṭis</s> of seven Perfectly Awakened Ones! Homage to all <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bodhisattvas</s> headed by <s>Maitreya</s>, together with the <s>Śrāvaka</s> communities! Homage to the <s>Arhats</s> in the world! Homage to the Stream-Enterers (<s>srotaāpanna</s>)! Homage to the Once-Returners (<s>sakṛdāgāmin</s>)! Homage to the Non-Returners (<s>anāgāmin</s>)! Homage to those in the world who have rightly gone! Homage to those who rightly practice! Homage to the divine <s>ṛṣis</s>! Homage to the divine <s>Brahmā</s>! Homage to the <s>Buddha</s>! Homage to the Blessed <s>Rudra</s>, together with <s>Umāpati</s>! Homage to <s>Varuṇa</s>! Homage to the Blessed <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>! Homage, homage to the five great <s>mudrās</s>! Homage to the Blessed <s>Nandikeśvara</s>-<s>Mahākāla</s>, who causes the destruction of the triple city (<s>Tripura</s>), who dwells in the great cremation ground of <s>Kaśmīra</s> with devotion! Homage [to him] together with the hosts of Mothers (<s>mātṛgaṇa</s>)! Homage to the Blessed <s>Tathāgata</s> family! Homage to the Blessed <s>Padma</s> (Lotus) family! body.translated_text: the pacifier of all strife, quarrel, conflict, and dispute; the averter of all <s>bhūta</s>-spirit seizures; the cutter of all hostile spells; the savior from untimely death; the liberator of all beings from bondage; the destroyer of all evil dreams; the destroyer of <s>yakṣa</s>, <s>rākṣasa</s>, and <s>graha</s> (planetary) seizures; the destroyer of eighty-four thousand <s>grahas</s>; the propitiator of the twenty-eight <s>nakṣatras</s> (lunar mansions); the averter of all enemies and destroyer of the eight great <s>grahas</s>; the annihilator of terrible, malicious evil dreams; the deliverer from poison, weapons, fire, and water; the deliverer from fear of all bad destinies; the protector from up to eight untimely deaths — the unconquered, greatly fierce, greatly powerful, greatly radiant, greatly wrathful, greatly white, greatly blazing, with great garlands, with great flames, the great wearer of white!

body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ ṛṣigaṇapraśaste sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatre hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ ṣṭroṃ jambhani</s> (paralyzer)! <s>Hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ ṣṭroṃ stambhani</s> (immobilizer)! <s>Oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ ṣṭro</s>, she who immobilizes hostile spells! <s>Hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ ṣṭroṃ</s>, she who destroys all <s>yakṣa</s>, <s>rākṣasa</s>, and <s>graha</s> seizures! <s>Hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ ṣṭro</s>, she who destroys eighty-four thousand <s>grahas</s>! <s>Hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ ṣṭro</s>, she who propitiates the twenty-eight <s>nakṣatras</s>! <s>Hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ ṣṭro</s>, she who destroys the eight great <s>grahas</s>! <s>Hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ ṣṭroṃ</s> — protect, protect me and all beings!

One will become dear to all <s>grahas</s> (seizing spirits) and all <s>vighnavināyakas</s> (obstructing demons). One will become endowed with the aggregate of merit of <s>Buddhas</s> as innumerable and immeasurable as the sands of the river Ganges.
